_metadata.description: Persisted settings with validated partial updates and processor side-effects, plus health endpoint and stale-task recovery (OT-P0-003, OT-P0-004).

requirements.title: Settings persist across restarts
requirements.description: Slots/cooldown/agent settings are persisted to disk and reloaded on startup; reads return the persisted state.

requirements.title: Validated partial updates
requirements.description: Partial settings updates are validated and normalized before being applied; invalid values are rejected and UI-range constraints are honored.

requirements.title: Reset to defaults and concurrent access safety
requirements.description: Settings can be reset to defaults, and concurrent reads/writes are safe.

requirements.title: /health endpoint on the root router
requirements.description: The /health endpoint responds on the dynamically configured path, reports database connectivity state, and serves over the real HTTP server.

requirements.title: Stale-task recovery on startup
requirements.description: On startup the processor reconciles in-progress tasks left behind by a crash, without moving tasks whose cleanup is already verified.

requirements.title: Automatic WebSocket reconnection
requirements.description: The UI WebSocket client reconnects automatically after a dropped connection and resumes live task updates without a page reload.

validation.notes: Reconnect logic exists in the UI but has no automated evidence yet; write a vitest (e.g. ui/src hooks WebSocket reconnect test) covering backoff + resubscribe, then convert this entry to type=test.
